giver: The spirits of the Twilight Forest, through signs and the trophies of fallen guardians
feel: Fairy-tale exploration in three parts: each guardian lifts a curse and opens the next land

quests.title: Through the Pool
quests.summary: The pool you ringed with flowers is shimmering; step in and wake in the Twilight Forest, the spirits' own realm, under its endless dusk.
quests.reward: Exploration kit: torches, bread, a Twilight oak sapling

quests.title: Lanterns of the Dusk
quests.summary: Walk into a Firefly Forest and catch fireflies and cicadas in jars (glass bottles) to light your first camp on the other side.

quests.title: The Wary Raven
quests.summary: Forest ravens take flight at the slightest noise; sneak up and take a raven feather, the key ingredient of the realm's maps.

quests.title: A Map That Draws Itself
quests.summary: Bind a raven feather, torchberries and glowstone into a Magic Map Focus, then a Magic Map that charts biomes and marks every landmark around the portal.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a spare magic map

quests.title: Atlas of the Twilight
quests.summary: Set foot in the Enchanted Forest, the Mushroom Forest, the Spooky Forest and the Oak Savannah, noting which lands are still veiled by curses.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Charm of Life

quests.title: Inside the Hollow Hill
quests.summary: A grassy mound hides a cavern full of ores, spider spawners and redcaps; break in, raid its chests and come out with steeleaf.

quests.title: Leaf-Steel
quests.summary: Forge steeleaf ingots into a steeleaf pickaxe or chestplate, the realm's first native gear that grows enchantments of its own.

quests.title: The Serpent's Court
quests.summary: The magic map shows a walled courtyard of nagastone; find the Naga Courtyard and scout its broken pillars before the guardian wakes.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, a stack of food

quests.title: Coils of the Naga
quests.summary: The Naga charges in loops through the courtyard; dodge its rushes and strike its segments until it falls, lifting the first curse.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a healing potion bundle, golden apples

quests.title: Scales of the Serpent
quests.summary: Turn the Naga's scales into a Naga Scale chestplate and leggings, armour that shrugs off knockback.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a Naga banner pattern

quests.title: The Questing Ram
quests.summary: In a ring of stone in the Quest Grove grazes the Questing Ram, who wants wool of all sixteen colours; feed it one of each and see what it leaves behind.
quests.reward: Farming XP, the Questing Ram's treasure

quests.title: Living Iron
quests.summary: Dig liveroot from the forest floor, craft it with iron and gold into raw ironwood, and smelt ironwood ingots.

quests.title: Ironwood Arsenal
quests.summary: A Spartan smith's pattern takes ironwood well: craft an ironwood weapon from the Spartan Twilight line, a glaive, katana or halberd.

quests.title: The Glowing Spire
quests.summary: A giant mushroom tower rises in the Mushroom Forest; find the way up through its caps and stems to the loot at the top.

quests.title: Thorns in the Hedge
quests.summary: Hedge spiders lurk in the Hedge Maze's walls; reach the chests at its centre and get back out within ten minutes, before the spiders swarm.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Crumble Horn or Peacock Fan from the chests

quests.title: The Lich's Spire
quests.summary: With the Naga gone the Lich Tower opens; climb its winding stairs and painting rooms, past skeleton druids and the tower's spawners.

quests.title: Shields of the Lich
quests.summary: The Lich hides behind spinning shields and clones; break the shields with ranged blows, ignore the copies, and end it at the tower's crown.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a Charm of Keeping, golden carrots

quests.title: The Lich's Sceptres
quests.summary: Among the Lich's treasures lie the Twilight, Lifedrain, Zombie and Fortification sceptres; claim one and use it in battle.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a sceptre refill (ender pearls or rotten flesh)

quests.title: The Choking Swamp
quests.summary: The Lich's fall clears the fog over the Swamp, but mosquito swarms and hunger still haunt it; cross it in search of the labyrinth.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a stack of cooked food

quests.title: Map of the Maze
quests.summary: Upgrade your Magic Map Focus into a Maze Map Focus and craft a Maze Map that traces corridors underground.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a spare maze map

quests.title: Halls of the Labyrinth
quests.summary: Below the swamp sprawls the Labyrinth, with maze slimes and trapped vaults; map it, find the Mazebreaker Pickaxe or Ore Magnet in its vaults.
quests.reward: Mining XP, maze map, a Mazebreaker Pickaxe hint

quests.title: Horns in the Dark
quests.summary: Minotaurs pace the labyrinth halls; bring down five and take a Minotaur Axe from them.

quests.title: The Minoshroom
quests.summary: At the labyrinth's heart waits the Minoshroom, charging with its diamond axe; bait its charge into walls and finish it.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a Diamond Minotaur Axe, healing potions

quests.title: Meef Stroganoff
quests.summary: Taste the Minoshroom's meef stroganoff, then hunt raw meef from minotaurs and cook enough for your next trip.

quests.title: Unmaking Things
quests.summary: Build an Uncrafting Table and break down an old enchanted item into its parts.

quests.title: Three Trophies
quests.summary: Gather the Naga, Lich and Minoshroom trophies; the first part of the spirits' realm is free.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, an ironwood chest of supplies

quests.title: Back to the Dusk
quests.summary: The forest calls again: the Minoshroom's death has cleared the Fire Swamp's smoke, and the Dark Forest has begun to stir.

quests.title: Through the Fire Swamp
quests.summary: Fire jets and lava pools fill the Fire Swamp; brew fire resistance and push through to the Hydra's lair.

quests.title: The Hydra's Lair
quests.summary: Find the lair cut into the swamp's hill and the Hydra waiting inside.

quests.title: Three Heads Burning
quests.summary: The Hydra spits fire and mortars; strike its heads when they open, before they regrow, until the body falls.
quests.reward: Range XP, hydra chops, fiery blood

quests.title: Fire in the Metal
quests.summary: Combine fiery blood with iron to forge fiery ingots, the hottest metal of the realm.

quests.title: Under the Black Canopy
quests.summary: The Dark Forest is lit by nothing; brave its blindness and the goblins, redcaps and hostile wolves that roam it.

quests.title: Seeds of Wonder
quests.summary: Rare saplings of the Tree of Time, Tree of Transformation, Miner's Tree and Sorting Tree hide in the Dark Forest; grow one and set its heart working.

quests.title: The Phantom Stronghold
quests.summary: Beneath the Dark Forest lies the Knight Stronghold; find the trapdoor in, past goblin knights and helmet crabs.

quests.title: Shards of Armour
quests.summary: Collect armour shards from goblin knights and the stronghold's chests and press them into knightmetal ingots.

quests.title: Six Phantom Knights
quests.summary: In the stronghold's throne room six Knight Phantoms rise one after another; outlast them all.
quests.reward: Defense XP, Phantom armour piece, golden apples

quests.title: Block and Chain
quests.summary: Craft a Block and Chain or a Knightmetal Shield, the weapons the phantoms' metal was made for.

quests.title: Knightly Arms
quests.summary: Use knightmetal for a Spartan Twilight weapon: a knightmetal longsword, lance or warhammer.

quests.title: The Dark Tower
quests.summary: At the Dark Forest's centre stands a towerwood spire; climb past towerwood borers, ghastguards and carminite golems, triggering the builder blocks to climb.

quests.title: Carminite Hearts
quests.summary: Harvest carminite from ghastlings and golems and destroy the carminite reactors that keep the tower's defences alive.

quests.title: Tears of the Ur-Ghast
quests.summary: Atop the tower the Ur-Ghast cries fire; break the reactors when it retreats, then strike it down.
quests.reward: Range XP, fiery tears, a stack of arrows

quests.title: The Fiery Set
quests.summary: With fiery tears and blood, finish a full suit of fiery armour or a fiery sword and pickaxe.

quests.title: Weapons of Flame
quests.summary: Forge a fiery Spartan Twilight weapon, a greatsword, scythe or heavy crossbow that sets enemies alight.

quests.title: Six Trophies
quests.summary: Add the Hydra, Knight Phantom and Ur-Ghast trophies to your hall; the forest's middle lands are free.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, a Charm of Life II

quests.title: The Cold Reaches
quests.summary: The forest's snowy forest has opened; cross it through blizzards, winter wolves and falling ice.

quests.title: Caves of the Yeti
quests.summary: Find the yeti cave in the snowy forest and hunt yetis for arctic fur.

quests.title: The Alpha Yeti
quests.summary: The Alpha Yeti hurls ice and roars the ceiling down; wait for it to tire, then strike.
quests.reward: Attack XP, alpha yeti fur, ice bombs

quests.title: Armour of Fur
quests.summary: Sew arctic fur into arctic armour that can be dyed and keeps the cold out.

quests.title: The Aurora Palace
quests.summary: On the Glacier stands the Aurora Palace of ice; climb its halls past snow guardians and ice cores to the queen's chamber.

quests.title: The Snow Queen
quests.summary: The Snow Queen summons ice shields and hammers you from above; break her guard and bring her down.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a Charm of Keeping III

quests.title: Caves of the Trolls
quests.summary: The Highlands open at last; search the troll caves under them for trollsteinn and the vault holding the Lamp of Cinders.

quests.title: Burn the Thorns
quests.summary: The Lamp of Cinders burns away the thorns of the Thornlands; carve a path to the Final Plateau.

quests.title: The Unfinished Castle
quests.summary: On the plateau stands the final castle, sealed behind force fields and still unfinished; reach its gate and see what waits for the realm next.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, a Twilight Forest trophy pedestal

quests.title: A Hall of Trophies
quests.summary: Build a hall in your base and mount all eight trophies on pedestals: Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, Knight Phantom, Ur-Ghast, Alpha Yeti, Snow Queen.
quests.reward: Exploration XP, a Questing Ram trophy
